capabilities: Build dashboard grids of icon tiles that open notes, folders, canvases, or nested boards
Arrange sticky notes, checklists, images, audio, bookmarks, and note links on a freeform canvas
Manage kanban columns with drag-and-drop, WIP limits, and note links
Auto-sort imported assets into _Assets subfolders and relink broken file paths
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is a full visual workspace (canvas, kanban, sticky notes, media), not just a launcher of icon tiles.
extras: Beta-stage plugin: screenshots are pending, manual installation is described for beta testers, and the community plugin browser listing is not yet available. Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Boards save automatically into the .iboard file with no external database or sync service.
intentEvidence: A Milanote-style visual workspace with icon tiles, freeform canvas, kanban columns, sticky notes
problem: Obsidian has no single-file visual workspace that combines an app-launcher-style icon grid, freeform canvas with connected cards, and kanban columns in one place.

relations.evidence: A Milanote-style visual workspace with icon tiles, freeform canvas

summary: Visual board plugin that stores Milanote-style workspaces in .iboard files, with icon tile grids, a freeform canvas, kanban columns, sticky notes, checklists, and media.
